description: Angular component for alarm filter configuration in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, overlay panel toggling, and translation support.

classes.name: AlarmFilterConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring alarm filters with form controls, overlay panel, and translation features.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form and overlay, and clones initial config if needed.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the alarm filter configuration and updates form and button display.

methods.name: toggleAlarmFilterPanel
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for filter configuration.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Resets form to current config and closes overlay.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Saves current form as config and closes overlay.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets form to initial config if changed.

methods.name: updateAlarmConfigForm
methods.description: Updates form controls with given alarm filter config.

methods.name: alarmConfigUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal config and propagates change.

methods.name: alarmFilterConfigFromFormValue
methods.description: Creates AlarmFilterConfig object from form values.

methods.name: updateButtonDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates button label based on current filter config.

methods.name: customTranslate
methods.description: Performs custom translation for entity types.
